arc210_d.finding: Odd-N matching characterization is confirmed. Even-N has additional winning families and Bob obstructions: disjoint P3s, C4, a triangle-with-leaves obstruction, plus A2-A5 winning families. M0 even-N characterization was incomplete.

arc210_e.finding: Official solution confirms the multiplicative compression invariant: sums within a ratio-r-connected block may discard interiors/aggregate frequencies; retained state count is O(log_r(sum A)). This independently corroborates M0 component-compression structure.

arc210_f.finding: Official solution confirms weighted Bezout/Manhattan geometry for one difference and bounds each query to three target representatives, then requires 2D rectangular/trapezoidal aggregate queries in about O((N+Q)(log N+log Q)). M0 pair cost is correct but O(NQ) aggregation is constraint-unsafe.
